focus: New Test Team Member Knowledge Transfer Plan
topics: Audience: New Core Auth Test Validation Team member; scope: ATL105 and ISO8583 Test Solution responsibilities; owner: Test Lead or assigned KT coordinator; reusable onboarding plan
activity: Use as a two-week guided onboarding plan and adjust pace to experience and availability
expected_evidence: Member identity; mentor; Test Lead; KT start and target completion recorded
completion_criteria: Member understands the Test Solution is the independent validator and evidence producer, not the AI artifact generator

topics: Confirm access, mentor, Test Lead, authorized SME/TBA contact and available time; select bounded ATL105 and ISO8583 exercises; confirm source versions and unresolved applicability questions; select frozen review delivery or synthetic fixture; verify Java/Maven and required Python/Node tools; record pre-existing test failures; confirm approved source access and storage policy
activity: Prepare a bounded exercise package and environment checklist; preserve source identity and hashes; do not use AI output to create the oracle
expected_evidence: Access and environment checklist; assigned mentor; selected practice scopes; source/delivery identities; baseline test result
completion_criteria: No exercise begins with unknown source version, unapproved source access or an AI-derived oracle

topics: Core Auth purpose; stakeholders; Test Solution versus AI Solution ownership; milestone goals; repository; communication; branch and review practices
activity: Walk through a recent validation report from intake to disposition; member explains what it proves and does not prove
expected_evidence: Access confirmed; environment/readiness checklist; written summary of independent-validation boundary
completion_criteria: Member explains that AI claims, IDs, confidence, declared approvals and coverage are evidence under test, not authority

topics: Canonical package; schemas; adapters; traceability graph; specification packs; AIV controls; reports; test suites; distinction between validator controls and payment/message BRs
activity: Trace one validation control to implementation, regression test and generated evidence; run the smallest relevant test
expected_evidence: Control-to-code-to-test-to-report map; captured baseline result including pre-existing failures
completion_criteria: Member can identify common validator responsibilities versus specification-specific business rules

topics: Authoritative ATL105 2026-3; section, element and segment structure; canonical source anchors; rule catalogs; training status
activity: Using source material alone, draft a small source inventory and one atomic rule with exact section/page/line or repository-supported anchor evidence; only afterward compare with existing catalogs
expected_evidence: Draft source-backed rule/BR with provenance, applicability and open questions; mentor review
completion_criteria: Rule is independently derived, atomic and anchored; unresolved matters remain explicitly review-required

topics: BR taxonomy; source rule to BR to scenario to case to data; positive, negative, boundary, conditional and flow coverage; statuses; SME/TBA approval boundary
activity: Assess one existing chain for source continuity, completeness, explicit expected outcome, TD association, review state and execution evidence
expected_evidence: Chain assessment with evidence and pass/fail/review-required/blocked disposition
completion_criteria: Member distinguishes structural links from semantic correctness, approval and execution readiness

topics: AI intake; immutable delivery handling; package normalization; payload validation; independent coverage; discrepancy reporting; validation limitations
activity: Shadow mentor running bounded ATL105 validation; independently recalculate one reported metric from its eligible denominator and inspect one discrepancy
expected_evidence: Reproducible command/run notes; independent metric check; reviewed discrepancy record
completion_criteria: Member can reproduce a bounded check and describe its denominator and limitations

topics: First Data ISO8583 Global Version 2026-3; Global TA Addendum Version 2021-1a; message structure; source navigation; version and applicability controls
activity: Map a bounded message/transaction area to source sections; record terms, relationships and conflicts; do not merge clauses without an applicability/precedence decision
expected_evidence: Hash-backed source inventory for accessible copies; section map; open-decision/conflict entries where applicable
completion_criteria: Member flags unresolved source relationship or conflict rather than inferring precedence

topics: Existing Java patterns; reusable core versus specification-pack boundaries; focused test conventions; report generation; explicit failure handling
activity: Implement or extend one bounded validator predicate from an approved/source-backed rule; add positive, negative and boundary tests where the source defines expected outcomes
expected_evidence: Peer-reviewed change with regression test; documented validation boundary and non-claims
completion_criteria: Validator change is source-grounded and tested; it does not claim more than its predicate proves

topics: Frozen population; eligibility and denominator; risk stratification; independent oracle; reviewer evidence; finding classification
activity: After the independent rule baseline exists, review one mentor-selected AI BR-to-scenario-to-case-to-data flow against the specification and Test Solution oracle
expected_evidence: Review record with input identity/hash; source anchor; artifact references; expected outcome; finding; reviewer
completion_criteria: Member records evidence independently and does not use AI output as the oracle

topics: Integrated source analysis; independent rule authoring; automation; validation; review
activity: Lead a small assigned task such as one source-backed rule plus a linked validator check or one bounded AI-flow review; mentor observes and intervenes only if an evidence or safety boundary is at risk
expected_evidence: Complete work package: source evidence; implementation or assessment; tests/evidence; limitation/status; handoff notes
completion_criteria: Member completes task with appropriate peer review and explicit open questions

topics: Knowledge check; review feedback; gap assessment; SME/escalation path; next rotation
activity: Present the work package; explain decisions and unresolved issues; walk through a reviewer handoff; agree a 30-day development assignment
expected_evidence: Mentor sign-off or explicit gaps and follow-up plan; next work-package lead/reviewer assignment
completion_criteria: Member is assigned independent work only within demonstrated readiness; approval authority is not implied

topics: Derive Test Solution oracle from authoritative source before inspecting AI semantics; preserve source/version, input identity, hashes where required and evidence path
activity: Record sources and evidence for each conclusion; treat AI claims as evidence under test
expected_evidence: Traceable provenance and review evidence
completion_criteria: No AI-generated artifacts are copied into or treated as Test Solution training truth

topics: Ambiguous, conflicting, context-dependent or non-deterministic source rules; SME/TBA or formally delegated approval
activity: Use REVIEW_REQUIRED or NOT_ASSESSED and submit an authorized decision request; do not self-approve
expected_evidence: Open question with source anchor, owner and status
completion_criteria: Cross-training does not confer business-approval authority

topics: Structural completeness; confirmed matches; schema validity; bounded predicates; host or production execution; manual sample limits
activity: State exactly what each check proves and does not prove; separate structural, semantic, approval and execution claims
expected_evidence: Report with explicit scope, denominator, status and limitations
completion_criteria: No placeholder, link, schema pass or sample is presented as proof of full correctness

topics: AI artifact defects; validator defects; source interpretation; missing provenance; external dependencies; behavior changes
activity: Classify issue before action; preserve frozen AI input; add targeted regression tests for validator fixes
expected_evidence: Defect record; regression result; preserved input identity
completion_criteria: No silent AI input edits; intentional validator behavior changes are tested

topics: Repository storage/retention rules; sensitive and restricted material; oversized artifacts; separate author/reviewer
activity: Use approved storage and access; obtain a different resource's review for source rules, validator changes and acceptance evidence
expected_evidence: Reviewer identity and decision; compliant evidence location
completion_criteria: No credentials, restricted source, sensitive values or oversized artifacts are published contrary to policy

topics: ATL105 closure; ISO8583 validation; scope; schedule; cross-trained resource and review model
activity: Read and discuss with mentor
expected_evidence: Questions and assigned bounded practice scope recorded
completion_criteria: Member understands current milestone scope and unresolved dependencies

completion_criteria: No segment addendum bypasses a common phase or gate

activity: Trace an assigned artifact or report to its producer and inputs

topics: Validator assurance controls; methods; evidence; boundaries

topics: Append-only decisions; review states; authorized approvals; promotion limits
